skins.name: Bubble Lift

skins.description: Ice-blue translucent cards, a bright upper edge and soft depth.

skins.name: Comic Burst

skins.name: Pastel Pop

skins.name: Esports Slash
skins.description: Lime name plates and opposing diagonal ends; only the frame is slanted.

skins.name: Quiet Line

skins.name: Neon Edge

skins.description: Mint receipt-like command blocks with amber prompts; no typing delay.

skins.name: Announcer
skins.description: Oversized gold names headline compact dark lower thirds.

skins.description: Teal tactical pane with squared corner brackets and an aligned squad column.

skins.name: Battle Royale
skins.description: Sand-yellow notched field cards; condensed names and individual charcoal plates.

skins.name: Retro RPG Dialog Box
skins.description: Cobalt dialogue window with a bright twin rim and triangular speaker prompt.

skins.name: Cyber City
skins.description: Magenta cut-corner panels and cyan callsigns; a hard-edged city HUD.

skins.name: Arcade Cabinet
skins.description: Purple cabinet bezel, butter-yellow score names and static scanlines.

skins.name: Space Command
skins.description: Steel-blue communications panel with long technical corner brackets.

skins.name: Monster Trainer
skins.description: Ivory dialogue cards with a heavy blue-ink rim and friendly tall lettering.

skins.name: Dungeon Crawler
skins.description: Stone-grey bevel, small brass corner diamonds and firelit serif names.

skins.name: Cozy Farm
skins.description: Warm wood plaques, cream lettering and small peg dots at the corners.

skins.name: Horror Survival
skins.description: Dusty red emergency slips; light body text instead of low-contrast blood red.

skins.name: Hero Shooter
skins.description: Orange start stripe with small white corner wedges and compact team calls.

skins.name: Kart Racer
skins.description: Sun-yellow racing capsules with a mint lane stripe; wide, playful spacing.

skins.name: Bubble Chat
skins.description: Classic pale lavender inline capsules; deliberately compact beside Bubble Lift.

skins.name: Clean
skins.description: Neutral navy reading strips with stronger backing and clear bold names.

skins.name: Candy Pop
skins.description: Pink candy tiles with cream-to-mint pastel fill and small diamond corners.

skins.name: Rainbow Border
skins.description: Prismatic static perimeter around a sober midnight card; white names stay still.

skins.name: Terminal
skins.description: A single forest-green console pane; plain prompts and no animated typing.

skins.name: Vaporwave
skins.description: Plum-to-ocean gradient ribbons with fine lilac twin lines and mint names.
